verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair axis for a cloud platform like AWS. The pack documents no data-retention policies, retention periods, or privacy-oriented deletion controls. The only related item is CloudFormation stack teardown, which is an adjacent infrastructure-lifecycle feature, not data retention control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can delete the stack just as easily, which deletes all the resources in the stack.
